final_candidates.decision_summary: WT Trp17 is verified in the sequence. Replacing a bulky aromatic residue with glutamate is expected to strongly perturb local packing and favor loss of stable PsaE folding.
WT Ile37 is verified in the sequence and lies in a hydrophobic-rich internal segment. A charged glutamate at this position is a plausible strong destabilizer while preserving full-length translation.
WT Tyr18 is verified and immediately follows Trp17. Aromatic-to-glutamate replacement should disrupt the local aromatic/hydrophobic environment and may compromise PsaE folding.

stop_reason.detail: No external evidence is available, and additional sequence-only reconsideration is unlikely to distinguish these leading destabilizing substitutions reliably.
